question: For the patients with an abnormal Ig M level, what is the most common disease they are diagnosed with?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN LabTest3 AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGM > 2000
GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1
